nominal.purpose: Measure ordinary task success and detect recovery-module regression

failure_start.purpose: Isolate recovery competence from pre-failure execution quality

online_failure.trigger: shared semantic event or sub-task boundary
online_failure.purpose: Evaluate detection, diagnosis, recovery, and task continuation end to end

recovery_levels.L1: Action retry; task state is materially unchanged
recovery_levels.L2: Action adaptation; object state changed but remains directly usable
recovery_levels.L3: Object-state restoration before the original task can continue
recovery_levels.L4: Environment restoration involving a blocking non-target state or object

humanoid_axes.H1: Body-state recovery: support, balance, foot placement, or recoverable fall state
humanoid_axes.H2: Policy-tracker failure: valid high-level intent is not realized by the whole-body tracker
humanoid_axes.H3: Coupled failure: body-state disruption and task/object-state disruption co-occur

task_seed_source.note: Task names seed coverage only; HRVLA recovery scenarios require their own recoverability oracle and event annotations

fairness_requirements: Identical initial and failure snapshots for every method in a comparison cell
Identical event boundary, perturbation parameters, and rollout seed
Identical observation permissions, action rate, time budget, and success predicate
Controller identity and revision reported; controller changes form a separate comparison
No retry outside the episode budget and no silent reset after failure
Every injected scenario is independently verified recoverable by an oracle policy or expert
All episode records, failed rollouts, exclusions, and seeds are retained
